result.summary: Found 2 issues: restaurant name text is clipped in two places, making titles unreadable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the Fastest near you row is cut off at the card edge, so the full name cannot be read.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to a second line, shrink the font, or use an ellipsis so the full or clearly truncated title remains readable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped on the right, cutting off the last letter so it reads as 'Tokumaru Ramer'.
issues.suggestion: Give the title enough width or allow wrapping so the full name is visible; do not let it collide with the rating on the right.
